correctness.rationale: The full-line L1 model yields Y_v=C H(v·) exactly. The speed ratio cancels the unknown field, and at geometrically contracted frequencies its finite product equals H(ω)/H(a^N ω); H(0)=1 yields the exact inverse and Fourier injectivity gives uniqueness. A single-speed positive exponential-kernel convolution-commutativity construction proves sharp necessity. Independently normalized observation moments yield exact first/second response and field moments. The standalone script has 12,800 supplementary checks, none used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The unknown sensor response versus unknown spatial pollutant field is a natural sensor-lag calibration confounding problem. A complete nonparametric identifiability result from exactly two controlled traversals, with a sharp one-speed obstruction and directly recovered physical delay moments, provides a precise baseline for assessing reference-free calibration design; no claim about actual field feasibility or stable numerical inversion.
